mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_key, name, config_json, reminder_enabled, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_daily_report_rule WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, rule_key, name, config_json, reminder_enabled, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_daily_report_rule WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey} AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_daily_report_rule (rule_key, name, config_json, reminder_enabled, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{ruleKey}, #{name}, CAST(#{configJson} AS JSON), #{reminderEnabled}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_daily_report_rule SET deleted_at = UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT display_name FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT feishu_open_id FROM sys_user WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 AND feishu_open_id IS NOT NULL AND feishu_open_id != '' AND id IN #{id}
SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 AND id IN #{id}
SELECT id FROM sys_department WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 AND id IN #{id}
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 AND id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND u.primary_department_id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 AND ur.role_id IN #{id}
SELECT id FROM sys_file WHERE uploader_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0 AND id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_daily_report_file_binding (submission_id, file_id, sort_order, created_by) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{fileId}, #{index}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_daily_report_file_binding SET deleted_at = UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_id, report_date, period_key, field_values_json, attachments_json, rule_snapshot_json, submitted_by_id, submitted_by_name, created_at FROM sys_daily_report_submission ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1000
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_daily_report_reminder_log (rule_id, user_id, report_date, reminder_time) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{userId}, #{reportDate}, #{reminderTime})
